reason: Classified as automation because the plugin’s primary user-facing function is to automate making a local DeepSeek Harness instance accessible from a phone: it launches/configures a tunnel, verifies service readiness, and optionally auto-sends the resulting URL through a chosen notification channel.

summaries.zh: 该插件提供一键启动与自动化流程，在本地 DeepSeek Harness 与手机之间通过 Cloudflare 隧道建立可访问链接，并按配置将该链接推送到所选通知渠道。
summaries.en: This plugin provides one-click and automatic workflows to expose a local DeepSeek Harness instance via a Cloudflare tunnel and send the mobile access link through a configured notification channel.

capabilities: starts and manages a Cloudflare quick tunnel for a local service
spawns/manages dsh web and tunnel-related processes
sends HTTP requests to external notification services
stores and reads channel credentials from local config
performs network reachability checks before sharing links

reasons.code: The plugin is documented as a one-click flow that creates/reuses a Cloudflare quick tunnel, starts dsh web with trusted-host handling, and pushes a mobile link via selectable channels.
It supports auto mode to run the same start/tunnel/verify/push workflow on dsh web startup, indicating ongoing background automation behavior.
Configuration and command options include Server酱/PushPlus/Bark/ntfy/custom webhook credentials and channel metadata, with local config path specified for storage.
Package metadata exposes a CLI entry point and depends on Node runtime tooling, consistent with terminal-based execution and process/network automation.
